Submit the target Source, Requirement, Resolution, Rule, Topic, or Question for review.

Usage: provenance [OPTIONS] <TARGET> [ACTION]

Arguments:
  <TARGET>  
  [ACTION]  [possible values: get, trace, create, update, answer, claim, release, submit, discussions, discussion, discuss, reply]

Options:
      --repo <REPO>                                          [default: .]
      --scope <SCOPE>                                        [default: default]
      --format <FORMAT>                                      [possible values: json]
      --quiet                                                
      --stdin                                                
      --actor <actor>                                        
      --title <title>                                        
      --declared-by <declared-by>                            
      --builds-on <builds-on>                                
      --confidence <confidence>                              
      --evidence-references <evidence-references>            
      --expected-revision <expected-revision>                
      --revises <revises>                                    
      --source-ids <source-ids>                              
      --summary <summary>                                    
      --actor-json <actor-json>                              
      --builds-on-json <builds-on-json>                      
      --confidence-json <confidence-json>                    
      --declared-by-json <declared-by-json>                  
      --evidence-references-json <evidence-references-json>  
      --expected-revision-json <expected-revision-json>      
      --revises-json <revises-json>                          
      --source-ids-json <source-ids-json>                    
      --summary-json <summary-json>                          
      --title-json <title-json>                              
  -h, --help                                                 Print help
